note: Published payload-range chart masses, the inputs of a chart-mass corner flight (alas_pipeline::quick_analysis::corners::chart_mass_corners, the kappa_calibration_probe path). tow_kg is the chart takeoff-mass line (or the preset variant MTOW when the chart does not print it), fuel_tank_kg the usable fuel of the chart's own document, delta_payload_kg the payload (A320, A340) or zero-fuel-mass (B787-9, OEW-free) difference between chart corners B and C. They are masses only: no chart range is stored here, so the flight cannot leak a reference into the model. Source: the kappa-calibration lane target files (v4_targets.json of fix-kappa-cal-2026-10-12); the chart-weight closures are discussed in that report. Units kg. reserve_rule: the reserve convention printed on each chart (scheme, alternate distance, final-reserve hold; absent fields are not printed and take the configured policy), with source and page; applied identically to every chart by chart_mass_corners (post-diagnosis definition fix 2026-10-13). cruise_mach (optional): the cruise Mach the chart prints, with source; when present chart_mass_corners flies the corners at it (the single cruise-Mach source is requirements.cruise_mach, which every printed value equals today).
